title: Met One 034B wind speed/direction sensor -QUOTE REQUEST
body: The 034B wind sensor combines wind speed and direction measurements in a single sensing unit. title: Met One 083E Humidity/Temp Probe - QUOTE REQUEST
body:
The Met One 083E relative humidity probe represents sensitivity, accuracy, linearity and stability not encountered with conventional relative humidity sensors. It is extremely well suited for meteorological, industrial, laboratory and other demanding applications.

The sensor can also be supplied with a temperature sensor mounted in it and used with various radiation shields for reliable, accurate measurements.

The 083E is based upon the capacitance change of a polymer thin film capacitor. A one-micron thick dielectric polymer layer absorbs water molecules through a thin metal electrode and causes capacitance change proportional to relative humidity. The thin polymer layer reacts very fast, and therefore, the response time is very short; less than five seconds to 90% of the final value of relative humidity.

title: Met One 092 barometric pressure sensor - QUOTE REQUEST
body:
Barometric pressure sensors convert absolute atmospheric pressure into a linear, proportional voltage, which may be used in any meteorological program. The Met One 092 barometric pressure sensor brings in modern digital computer technology. An on-board CPU scales pressure measurements, provides temperature compensation and controls communications output.

These sensors are inherently stable devices that do not require periodic service or routine recalibration.

The enclosure houses a solid state pressure transducer, with linearization and amplification electronics along with a low power embedded CPU. The sensor is contained within a small polycarbonate enclosure, and may be mounted outside or inside a building or other enclosure. Small inlet holes allow the atmospheric pressure access to the sensing element.

title: Met One 50.5 ultrasonic wind speed/direction sensor - QUOTE REQUEST
body:
The 50.5 Solid State Wind Sensor is a continuation of the development work started with NOAA on sonic wind sensors over 25 years ago. This sensor design contains the same wind distortion algorithm and factoring that has been proven and accepted in applications around the world.

No other sensor technology has the history of time proven field performance comparable to the Series 50.5 Sensor.
  • No moving parts
  • Digital and analog outputs
  • Built-in sensor emulation
  • 16-point wind tunnel calibration with each sensor
  • Data output is field set to user requirements
  • Optional heating unit allows continuous operation in ice and snow
  • Low maintenance

title: SAGE - Professional Soil Moisture Meter
body:
SAGE is a visual tensiometer visible from a distance that tells you when it’s time to irrigate and when to stop.

A gypsum block is placed directly in the root zone and within seconds will adjust to the surrounding soil moisture. The changes in soil moisture are sent to the visual display. The number of yellow coins indicates how wet or dry the soil conditions are. All seven coins are flipped for very wet soil, and one or none for very dry. For guidelines on optimal soil moisture level, consult our plant guide.

  • Durable waterproof display
  • Operates for years on two AA batteries
  • No calibration needed
  • Accurate and reliable
  • Quick to install
  • Simple to operate

One-year limited warranty (excl. AA batteries)

title: Stevens pF Sensor - QUOTE REQUEST
body:
The “matric potential” of soil (also called “soil water potential”) represents how much energy is needed to overcome this capillary forces holding water in the soil from the soil. It’s the pressure it takes to pull water out of soil, and increases as the soil gets drier. The matric potential changes with the soil water content and is highly variable from one soil type to the next.
  • Readings in “pF units” (the log of the pressure in Hectopascals or hPa
  • SDI-12 output

body:
The TS4000 incorporates a wide range of high performance radio modules, which meet the stringent demands of both domestic and international regulatory agencies. title: Tensiomark - REQUEST QUOTE
body:
The Tensiomark sensor measures the heat capacity in a porous equilibrium body. The changes of matric potential lead to increases or decreases of the heat capacity of the sensor head. The correlation of matric potential values and the measured heat capacity is achieved by a sensor-specific calibration curve.

5 m cable is included.

  • Completely maintenance-free (no filling required)
  • Unlimited measuring range (no missing values by dehydration)
  • Spontaneous reaction to moisture changes
  • No frost damage, no influence of salinity
  • SDI-12 output

body:
The Baro-Diver provides reliable automatic measurement and registration of groundwater level and temperature data. Measuring 0.86 inches (22 mm) in diameter and 3.54 inches (90 mm) in length, it is a great choice for virtually any monitoring well.

The Baro-Diver has a measurement range of 4.92 ft (1.5 m). For each measurement, the Baro-Diver simultaneously registers barometric pressure, groundwater temperature, date and time.

Based on proven, innovative technology, the Baro-Diver has an impressive internal memory capable of storing 24,000 measurements per parameter. This is essentially one measurement every ten minutes for six months.

  • Optional SDI-12 adapter for connection

Its internal memory of 24,000 measurements per parameter provides sufficient capacity to perform nearly one measurement every ten minutes for six months. title: Van Essen TD-Diver
body: The TD-Diver is a submersible datalogger for long-term uninterrupted, real-time water level monitoring using a pressure sensor when submerged at a fixed level under the water surface. The pressure sensor measures the equivalent hydrostatic pressure of the water above the sensor diaphragm to calculate the total water depth. The Diver autonomously measures pressure and temperature and records them in its internal memory. The Diver is ideal for ground and surface water level applications.
